College Football - Navy at Air Force

The Navy Midshipmen and the Air Force Falcons meet as part of the Commander-in-Chief's Trophy competition. Air Force beat Nevada in double overtime last week, while Navy lost against UAB, 24-20. Games against Army also determine the trophy winner.
College Football - Ohio State at Iowa

The No. 5 Ohio State Buckeyes battle the No. 14 Iowa Hawkeyes in Week 5 of college football at Kinnick Stadium. The Hawkeyes enter Week 5 with a perfect 4-0 record after defeating Michigan, 20-19. Ohio State (3-1) defeated Illinois, 42-19, in Week 4.

NFL Football - New England Patriots at Buffalo Bills

NFL Football - Los Angeles Chargers at Seattle Seahawks
